4589.title: Required skill transport failure
4589.rootCauseOneLine: An injected HTTP 500 rejects required-tree staging; the origin of the production 500 is unconfirmed.
4589.proposedFix: Identify and reproduce the endpoint or transport fault before designing a root-cause fix; do not skip required skills.
4589.caveats: Two clean trusted runs prove fault propagation and staging recovery, not the production 500 or actual turn.submit. Complete test source and sanitized outputs are inline in the report; public artifact files are forbidden by reports repository policy.
